sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sites"."phasefactor" AS g, AVG((CAST(("scanmesh"."geomdeltamm" - "scanmesh"."facetresmm") AS REAL) / "scanmesh"."facetresmm")) AS m1 FROM "scanmesh" JOIN "sites" ON "sites"."zoneregistry" = "scanmesh"."zoneref" GROUP BY "sites"."phasefactor"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
quantities: scanmesh.relative difference of geometric deviation from mesh vertex spacing
why: (geometric deviation - mesh vertex spacing) / mesh vertex spacing: the relative difference of two quantities in mm
average of relative difference of geometric deviation from mesh vertex spacing per sites.phasefactor
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of geometric deviation from mesh vertex spacing (all level)
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "scanprocessing"."zoneref" AS e, "sites"."typesite" AS g, AVG((CAST(("scanprocessing"."procgpu" - "scanprocessing"."proccpu") AS REAL) / "scanprocessing"."proccpu")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "scanprocessing" JOIN "sites" ON "sites"."zoneregistry" = "scanprocessing"."zoneref"  GROUP BY "scanprocessing"."zoneref", "sites"."typesite"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
quantities: scanprocessing.relative difference of GPU usage from CPU usage
why: (GPU usage - CPU usage) / CPU usage: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of GPU usage from CPU usage per sites within sites.typesite
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of GPU usage from CPU usage (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
